items.title: Annual / Selection Examination Routine Released (Nursery to Class X)
items.summary: The official schedule for the upcoming terminal and selection examinations has been published. Parents and students can download the class-wise PDF routine from the Academics section or by clicking the circular button below.

items.title: Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) for Classes VI to X
items.summary: All parents and guardians of Upper Primary and Secondary students are cordially requested to attend the Parent-Teacher Meeting to review student attendance and academic progress prior to the final examinations.
